sentences.text: Yes — for a floating rate business loan sanctioned on 2026-03-15 to an MSE, a Tier 3 UCB may levy pre-payment charges because the specific no-charge rule for a Tier 3 UCB applies only to loans with sanctioned amount / limit up to ₹50 lakh, and this loan is Rs 60 lakh.
For cases other than those in paragraph 261(1) and (2), pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB.
The directions at paragraph 261 apply to loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026, and the loan was sanctioned on 2026-03-15.
